responsibility: Implements Linux-specific D frontend hooks, including libc-sensitive OS version branding. It registers Posix and linux builtins, adds Android when applicable, selects the appropriate CRuntime_* builtin version based on the active libc option set (glibc, uClibc, Bionic, or musl), and reports ELF as the object format through D target-info handlers. This file is the D-language companion to linux.h/linux.opt.
